effect: Makes the bearer the only adult in the room for as long as the emergency lasts, and suspends the questions that were due this week.
tell: "Now is not the time to politicise this", from someone who has been politicising everything else since Tuesday.
expires: When the emergency is declared over - a decision the bearer also gets to make.

confused_with.tell: The indictbump is sympathy for a defendant; the crisisglow is authority for an incumbent. One is a wound, the other a uniform.

senses: A temporary condition in which an emergency converts the office-holder into the responsible one, and every objection into a distraction.

It works because urgency is real and disagreement is slow. A crisis genuinely does compress the timetable, and the bearer decides how long the compression lasts - which is why so few emergencies end on schedule.
example: *"For six weeks of **crisisglow** the mayor could not be criticised without someone asking whether you supported the recovery."*
